ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms reported outcomes, the input revision and the raw-secret flag are declared; it does not produce a report.
offer: Report mutation outcomes against the exact input revision and include inconclusive states. Redact sensitive input before any report leaves the producing environment.

minimal.reason: List the outcomes reported, including inconclusive states. Hiding some inflates the score, so include every category.

mid.reason: Record the exact input revision of the run. A report without a revision cannot be tied to code, so name the commit.

maximal.reason: Set publishing raw secrets to false. Reports leave the producing environment, so redact sensitive input first.

rule.reason: List the outcomes reported, including inconclusive states. Hiding some inflates the score, so include every category.
